newsitem.title: USA: Crescent Real Estate makes acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Crescent Real Estate makes acquisitions.

text.p: Crescent Real Estate Equities Inc said Tuesday it bought $65 million in real estate in Houston and New Orleans, plus a leased property in Austin, Tex.

Dallas Lucas, the real estate investment trust's chief financial officer, said it had bought a cash flow mortgage note secured by Three Westlake Park, a 414,000 square foot class A office building in Houston, Texas for $29 million or $70.05 per square foot.
The price was a 53-percent discount from the property's estimated replacement cost, it said.
Crescent said it had also acquired a 509,000 square foot class A office building next to the Superdome sports complex in New Orleans, at $36.5 million or $71.70 per square foot.
The price was a 54-percent discount from the property's estimated replacement cost, it said.

Crescent also said it had leased to BMC Software Inc a new 106,000 square foot office building to be developed as an expansion of The Avallon, its three-building, 125,000 square foot office development located in northwest Austin, Texas.
Construction is expected to be complete in October 1997 for about $11.9 million, it added.
